## Objective
- Continue building Evergreen as a playable, mobile-friendly family legacy simulator spanning 300 years of American history.
- Verify and repair the replacement game implementation in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Let players choose a start year from 1776 through the present.
- Include historical American events affecting the portfolio and family, with fictional events in the future.
- Transfer family-office control roughly every 20 years.
- Allow reckless heirs to impoverish the family and family members to leave for better prospects or after poor choices.
- Keep the standalone `index.html` game and localStorage saves.

## Decisions
- Use simplified historical events and randomized family traits.
- Show a founding-year selector before a new game begins.
- Succession may select returning or younger family members, and has an emergency recovery path to keep the office stewarded.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed heir eligibility to exclude spouses and consider eligible descendants, other active adults, returning adults, and younger family members.
- Added steward recovery for cases where the current steward is missing or deceased; returning heirs are reactivated.
- Made generated heir names unique, preventing an infinite loop when randomized names are exhausted.
- Passed syntax and mocked runtime checks for setup, family/ledger views, succession, reckless-heir losses, missing-steward recovery, save/load, reset, and the 300-year ending at 2076.

### Active
- Verify browser behavior and responsive layout in Chromium.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test the game in Chromium for browser-visible errors and responsive layout; the prior headless DOM dump was truncated and did not verify these.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Standalone game, styles, state, and gameplay implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-evergreen.cjs`: Mocked runtime test covering setup, succession, persistence, reset, and completion.
- `/tmp/opencode/evergreen.js`: Extracted script used for syntax checking.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier repository status showed `index.html` and other repository files as untracked.
